news.title: Avengers: Secret Wars — Multiversal Incursion Mechanics Revealed
news.summary: Marvel Studios unveils deep cosmological breakdown of the upcoming Secret Wars collision, detailing how timeline incursions, Battleworld domains, and legacy variants coalesce into one supreme battlefield.

news.title: X-Men 'From the Ashes': Mutantkind Reclaims Its Sovereign Destiny
news.summary: Following the fall of Krakoa, Jed MacKay and Ryan Stegman kick off a grit-infused new run with Cyclops, Wolverine, and Storm operating covert underground sanctuaries across North America.

news.title: The Infinity Gauntlet Retrospective: How Starlin Redefined Cosmic Stakes
news.summary: An archival deep-dive into Jim Starlin, George Pérez, and Ron Lim's seminal 1991 miniseries, analyzing the psychological anatomy of the Mad Titan and the universal consequences of the snap.

news.title: Ultimate Spider-Man: Jonathan Hickman's Adult Peter Parker Triumph
news.summary: Hickman and Checchetto's reinvention of Peter Parker as a married father of two taking on the Spider mantle at age 35 continues to dominate sales charts, delivering raw emotional storytelling.

news.title: Doctor Strange & The Sorcerer Supreme Order: New Mystic Realm Threats
news.summary: Following the mystical cataclysms of Blood Hunt, Stephen Strange and Clea re-fortify the Sanctum Sanctorum against extradimensional shadow entities seeping through shattered astral rifts.

news.title: Armor Wars: The Resurgence of Stolen Stark Sentinel Blueprints
news.summary: Feilong's weaponized Stark Sentinels leave a dangerous legacy. Tony Stark enters black-market cyber-warfare to trace counterfeit arc reactors being sold to international syndicates.
